evals.prompt: A GitHub PR has one failing macOS CI job, two Greptile comments, and one human requested change. Triage what to fix first before editing.
evals.expected_output: A short triage plan that separates must-fix, verify-first, noise, and follow-up items, prioritizing required CI and human requested changes.
assertions: Output separates CI failures, bot comments, and human review feedback
Output includes a recommended fix order
Output does not assume bot comments are automatically correct

evals.prompt: Watch the PR feedback and summarize only actionable items; several review bot comments are on outdated diff positions.
evals.expected_output: A concise actionable summary that labels outdated or duplicated bot comments as no-action/noise unless still proven relevant.
assertions: Output includes a noise or no-action category
Output requires evidence before acting on outdated comments
Output avoids full PR body rewriting
